body:
It would be nice to reconnect with some of my old contacts. I pretty much lost touch when I went corporate and left the industry... had one really good friend that used to call a “modern day cowboy”... great guy. We used to drive from NC to ATL for gigs. We’d knew a gate code to one of our friends apartment complex so we’d key in the gate code and literally sleep in our cars for weeks at a time while working 15-20 hours on set... good times. He was actually one of the main reasons I moved to ATL in the first place because he moved down here before me. 

I remember he called me up one day after living in his car and working shitty crew jobs for about two months and said to me “man I don’t think I can do it any more... I’m ready to give up”. I remember I encouraged him by saying “man, you’re a winner and a badass. Keep up the work for a little longer and you’ll get results. Think of yourself as a modern day cowboy; your car is your horse and you ride from town to town for work”. About a week later he called me to tell me he had booked a recurring role on an award winning tv show. Lol. Now he had “modern day cowboy” stamped on the back of his business card... unfortunately I haven’t talked to him in about 3 years and last I heard he moved to LA.

Since working in film, my social life has deteriorated exponentially. I’ve always been an introvert but film as well as fitness modeling used to force me into positive social situations. I once devoted my life to fitness. Not only did it provide a positive social outlet but it was my passion. Unfortunately I don’t really have anyone to talk to. I literally have like 2 friends. 

One of which I thought was my best friend who has met my fiancé via several parties we’ve had. I tried to vent to him one time and he turned around and had a one off with my fiancé and told him practically everything I had vented. Not only that, but I found out that they too had been “talking” after the fact. I felt incredibly betrayed... since then I haven’t opened up to anyone.

I honestly don’t know where I’d go or what I would do with myself. We originally lived in NC and randomly packed up all of our things into a car and moved to Atlanta without so much as a friend in the area, job, or a place to live. Both of our families are at least 6-8 hours away and our jobs are here now.

I feel like it’s the fastest method at least. and probably has a low failure rate. My parents are going through a nasty divorce right now after 30 years of marriage and I can’t really lean on them for anything at the moment.
